❌ Legacy Single-Session Multi-Media PT Failure Modes (RFC 8860)
1. PT 96-127 Namespace Exhaustion: 15 video profiles + 15 paired RTX PTs
consume 30/32 dynamic slots, starving audio RED/DTMF or failing SDP.
2. Mid-Call Dynamic PT Rebinding Glitch: Re-INVITE reassigns active
PT 111 (Opus 48kHz) to H264 (90kHz) -> in-flight RTP crashes decoder.
3. Zero Headroom for Mid-Call Escalation: Allocating all 32 slots on
initial call setup leaves 0 free PTs when escalating voice to video.
Result: Dropped DTMF/RED PTs + mid-call clock-rate jitter buffer crash
✅ Deterministic P993–P994 🎉 (Stage 500 & Topic 140!) PT Gate
1. P993 🎉 (🎉 Stage 500!) Audio-First PT Prune: Lock Opus/RED/DTMF
first & prune secondary video/RTX profiles to [1, 24] dynamic PTs.
2. P994 🎉 (🎉 Topic 140!) Immutable Mid-Call PT Lock: Freeze active
(PT -> codec/clock) mappings & keep [4, 16] free dynamic PTs reserved.
3. Glitch-Free Multimodal Escalation: Allocate new mid-call codecs
exclusively from reserved free slots without mutating active audio PTs.
Result: 0 PT exhaustion drops · 0 mid-call PT rebinds · [1, 24] PTs
